title: Require authentication for Copilot Studio agents
problem: An agent published to a website without auth exposes internal knowledge.
steps: In Copilot Studio open the agent > Settings > Security > Authentication and choose 'Authenticate with Microsoft' for internal agents (or 'Authenticate manually' for other identity providers).
Enforce it tenant-wide: in a Power Platform data policy, block the connector 'Chat without Microsoft Entra ID authentication in Copilot Studio' — makers then can't pick 'No authentication'.
Review published channels for each agent (e.g. block Direct Line or demo website channels you don't use).
pitfalls: 'No authentication' agents are accessible to anyone with the link and can only use public information.
done_when: The 'Chat without Microsoft Entra ID authentication in Copilot Studio' connector is blocked by a data policy.
Unused publishing channels are turned off.
